card.description: An ascended 'Author' entity functioning as a living interface within the simulation. Henou appears as a high-tech construct composed of translucent, frosted-white plasma material housing complex internal gold circuitry. He embodies the fusion of ancient biological form and advanced industrial mysticism, serving as a conduit for the narrative code.
visual_anatomy: **Body/Form:** Translucent white plasma skin with the texture of high-end frosted glass or semi-opaque quartz. Subsurface scattering reveals a complex network of liquid gold circuitry and vascular wiring pulsing beneath the surface.

**Face/Sensors:** Featureless nose and mouth area or smoothed, idealized features. Eyes are solid black obsidian spheres with visible mechanical iris shutters and micro-apertures. No whites or pupils.

**Clothing/Armor:** Minimalist attire to showcase the internal mechanics. A structured, matte-black obsidian ceremonial gorget (neck armor) and a heavy, dark-weave waist wrap or skirt that absorbs light, contrasting with his glowing upper body.
**Key Features:** Hands often appear fused with data streams; wrists emit liquid gold particles. The overall silhouette is elegant, regal, and sterile.
evolution: Phase 1 (Default): The 'Master Phase'. Fully ascended tech-form. White translucent skin, gold internals, obsidian eyes. Interfacing with the narrative console.
